user_saw: Changing the visitor cap or default expiry while agent turns were active caused Gateway readiness checks to fail and delayed new runs.
summary: The fix applies Visitor Access limit changes in place and lets prepared turns borrow the running service when their settings match the committed Gateway config.
reasoning: The original Visitor Access diff passed registration-time settings to the service and documented a Gateway restart after config edits, so those settings were designed to stay fixed for the life of the service. The #161267 diff added borrowing of live Gateway plugin instances by prepared agent runtimes, and its commit message explicitly records that a held turn can make replacement wait for the existing drain. I checked that the fix's parent still routed exclusive replacement through that drain, which is the path numeric limit edits now bypass.
